# TIBLOGICS

> AI implementation studio. We build AI agents, workflow automation and
> full-stack digital products for small and mid-size businesses across North
> America, Africa and beyond — and we run our own ventures on the same stack.

## What we do
- AI Implementation & Agents: custom agents, LLM integration, RAG, workflow automation
- Workflow Automation: n8n, Make, Zapier and custom pipelines
- AI Strategy & Consulting: readiness audits, roadmaps, and honest answers about where AI does not fit
- Web & App Development, Mobile, Cybersecurity, Data Analytics, System Design & IoT
